title: ChestLoot
description: This mod will modify the loot tables of chests.
body:
Adapted version:fabric_version=0.92.6+1.20.1 && loader_version=0.18.4

This mod will modify the loot tables of chests,generate any registered items inside the box.You can modify the things generated by the box, as well as the weights and quantities, through the configuration file.Although not mandatory, I strongly recommend installing the following modules:modmenu-7.2.2 && cloth-config-11.1.136-fabric

If you need the source code of my mod, you are allowed to decompile it yourself.

适配的版本：fabric_version=0.92.6+1.20.1 && loader_version=0.18.4

这个模组会修改箱子的战利品标，让箱子内生成已注册的任何物品。你可以通过配置文件修改箱子生成的东西，以及权重，还有数量。虽然不是必须的，但是我强烈建议安装以下模组：modmenu-7.2.2 && cloth-config-11.1.136-fabric

如果需要我的模组的源码，允许自行反编译我的模组。
